Name: Healthy Apple
Desc: A healthy apple, from a healthy tree

Name: Golden Apple
Desc: A golden one, lucky you!
Stat: Recover <green>15%</font> of your max health, and give you <yellow>1.5x</font> attack buff for a short amount of time

Name: Fireball Spell
Desc: A simple spell, using magic as a combustible fuel and applying sufficient force to boost it in the direction of the enemy, practically creating a fireball
Stat: Unleash a searing Fireball that deals 1x magic damage to your enemy. With a quick cast, you'll ignite them, inflicting a painful <red>Burn</font> over time.

Name: Health Potion
Desc: Brewed by the great alchemists of the Magic Guild in cooperation with the Life Guild for medical advancements, now distributed globally

Name: Power Potion
Desc: Originally crafted by Magic Guild alchemists to provide strength to construction workers, now a staple amongst adventurers. It can be found wherever danger calls
Stat: Gives you <red>1.75x Attack</font> buff for a decent amount of time

Name: Magic Potion
Desc: Brewed by the great alchemists of the Magic Guild to serve as a booster for sorcerer cubes, however it could be watered down into a safer substance that could be used by mages for emergency use
Stat: Gives you <purple>1.75x Magic</font> buff for a decent amount of time

Name: Mana Potion
Desc: Invented with the cooperation of the Magic Guild and Life Guild's scientists and researchers to create an energy enhancing drink for people of all lifestyles

Name: Endurance Potion
Desc: Brewed by the great alchemists of the Magic Guild in cooperation with the Life Guild for medical advancements

Name: Traveller's Boots
Desc: A pair of comfortable boots for adventurers to wear

Name: Burning Torch
Desc: A magical torch which burns even in rain

Name: Hunting Dagger
Desc: A sly, portable, and sharp dagger made for hunting foxes and wolves alike

Name: Mining Pickaxe
Desc: An impossibly sturdy pickaxe capable of mining a seemingly endless amount of ores

Name: Copper Sword
Desc: You can feel the blade is still warm despite it's evidently cold handle, an edge ridged and scratched, stained with the faint echo of a lingering history

Name: Ancient Hammer
Desc: Feeling the slight weight of the hammer, the tremors of past battles emanate throughout your body as you hold it

Name: Mana Crystal
Desc: A crystal of raw mana, rough and unpolished, containing only residual traces of energy within

Name: Slime Gel
Desc: A viscous, slightly iridescent goo harvested from a defeated slime. It's surprisingly sticky and has a faint, earthy smell

Name: Slime Core
Desc: Gelatinous orb is the very heart of a slime. It pulses with a weak, residual energy, hinting at the creature's simple, yet persistent, life force

Name: Spiky Fur
Desc: Rough and bristly, this fur was shed from a creature with formidable defenses. It's surprisingly durable and offers a unique kind of protection

Name: Spiky Quills
Desc: Sharp and rigid, these quills were shed from a creature of the forest, perhaps as a warning. They're surprisingly sturdy and can be used for various crafts

Name: Bee Stinger
Desc: A formidable barb detached from a giant bee. It still secretes a tiny amount of potent venom and serves as a sharp reminder of the hive's defense

Name: Crimson Slime Core
Desc: This pulsating, gooey orb is the heart of a fearsome Crimson Slime. It throbs with raw, unstable energy

Name: Crimson Slime Fang
Desc: A surprisingly sharp, crystalline growth extracted from the core of an Elder Crimson Slime. It's unnervingly warm to the touch and hums with a viscous, destructive energy

Name: Black Fur
Desc: A coarse, dark fur, torn from the hide of the formidable Wolf King. It still carries the scent of ancient forests and the wild, untamed power of its former owner

Name: Black Wolf Necklace
Desc: A totem carved from dark wood and adorned with a single, sharp tooth. Legend says it grants the wearer the cunning and speed of a Black Wolf

Name: Dragon Fang
Desc: Legend has it that the sharpest blades are forged from a dragon's fang

Name: Dragon Scale
Desc: It once shielded the dragon from harm, and now it can shield you!

Name: Iron Ore
Desc: A classic metal, used by civilisations across the ages

Name: Climbing Hook
Desc: A tool used by the civilization that lived among the highest mountains.
Stat: Allows you to climb <grey>highlighted grey</font> walls

Name: Divine Blade
Desc: Forged from the tears of a fallen war-god, this blade hums with the divine authority of the Astral Orders. Its edge reflects constellations, and its weight, though seemingly unbearable to mortals, becomes feather-light for those blessed by Northern Stronghold.

Name: Sylvan Whisper
Desc: Crafted from supple forest wood, is nearly silent when drawn. Arrows loosed from it fly true, guided by the unseen spirits of the woods

Name: Rootbound Spire
Desc: Appearing as if grown directly from the earth, allows its wielder to tap into the deep magical currents that flow beneath the forest floor

Name: Crescendo
Desc: Crescendo is a musical term meaning 'gradually getting louder', but perhaps, it has another meaning here...

Name: Honey Armor
Desc: This armor is surprisingly resilient and sticky to the touch. It offers sweet protection, and perhaps a little extra grip!

Name: Honey Armor
Desc: This armor is surprisingly resilient and sticky to the touch. It offers sweet protection, and perhaps a little extra grip!

Name: Wooden Sword
Desc: A simple practice sword, whittled from common wood. Every hero's journey begins with humble tools like this

Name: Wooden Bow
Desc: Crudely fashioned but effective, this bow is perfect for a budding archer. Its simplicity belies its potential in the right hands

Name: Wooden Staff
Desc: A basic staff, perhaps just a sturdy branch found in the woods. It hums with the faintest whisper of magic, ready for a novice spellcaster.

Name: Winter Howl
Desc: This jagged greatsword, rumored to be a single, massive tooth from the legendary wolf, still shimmers with the lava. Its edge howls with the ferocity of the Wolf King himself.
Stat: For every attack, it will has a low chance to inflict <red>Bleed</font> to enemy

Name: Apiary's Fury
Desc: Crafted from the hardened chitin of the Queen Bee, this elegant bow buzzes with a faint, sweet hum. Arrows loosed from its string fly with the speed and precision of a stinging insect, leaving a trace of venomous magic.

Name: Verdant Heartwood
Desc: Carved from the very core of the ancient tree the Forest Dragon guarded, this staff pulses with the raw, untamed energy of the deep woods. Its touch awakens dormant nature magic, allowing the wielder to command vines, thorns, and the very breath of the forest.

Name: Dawn
Desc: We crash against the sky, defy the judgements of all. End the darkness and seize the light, daybreaks meant to be free, and we are gonna shatter the tides!

Name: Heaven Potion
Desc: A luminous, golden elixir that smells faintly of starlight and fresh rain. Drinking it feels like a glimpse of paradise, completely rejuvenating your spirit and mending even grievous wounds

Name: Agility
Desc: A simple skill that can be easily learnt by anyone, allowing them a burst of speed for a short period of time
Stat: Grants <blue>1.5x</font> speed for a decent amount of time

Name: Jump Boost
Desc: A minor enchantment that subtly lightens your steps. With this, you can defy gravity for just a moment longer, reaching new heights.

Name: Arcane Spellbook
Desc: Ancient tome hums with dormant power. Its pages hold forgotten incantations and complex rituals, waiting for a true mage to unlock their secrets

Name: Magician's Hat
Desc: More than just a stylish accessory, it is rumored to be enchanted with a slight spatial distortion, making small items vanish and reappear with a flourish

Name: Enchanted Blade
Desc: A finely crafted sword that shimmers with a faint, otherworldly glow. It feels lighter than its weight suggests and hums softly when danger is near

Name: Sharperner's Rock
Desc: A rock used for sharpening your weapons

Name: Withering Overture
Desc: A blade forged with the essence of corruption, harboring an unimaginable power at the cost of its wielder's life. It brims with such an intense yet heinous force of magic, one could mistake it for a cursed blade, however it could not be farther from the truth. It overpowers any sort of energy it interacts with, overriding it with itself, giving it—its signature trait to create severely infected wounds with ease.
Stat: Wielding it will reduce your health every second, for every attack, it will has a low chance to inflict <purple>Poison</font> to enemy

Name: Lantern
Desc: A reliable source of light, burns brighter than a torch.

Name: Mana Lantern
Desc: Despite being simply a magical lantern, you can feel the magic emanating from it being pulled by an unseen force―deep within the Corrupted Cavern

Name: Mana Lantern Recipe
Desc: Despite being simply a magical lantern, you can feel the magic emanating from it being pulled by an unseen force―deep within the Corrupted Cavern

Name: Crimsonite Ore
Desc: An artificial ore formed due to the influence of the Crimson Slime on the cavern, having overtaken whatever material it originally could've been

Name: Crimsonite Ingot
Desc: You can smell the sickening stench of corruption that mists the ingot

Name: Glass
Desc: A transparent material made from heating sand until molten and then rapidly cooling it to prevent crystalization. Don't drop it though, it's very brittle!

Name: Sand
Desc: Despite coming from a slime, still can utilized. Don't know why you didn't just craft a shovel for this though

Name: Coal Ore
Desc: A solid carbon-rich source of fuel, made from ancient plant life which has since then been compacted and hardened beneath the earth

Name: Wood
Desc: Why does it take so long to cut this down? What is this thing made out of-? Oh

Name: Alderite Axe
Desc: Forged from Iron Ore with the helper of Kitsune Flame, this axe possesses an unnatural weight and a cutting edge that seems to hum with a strange, resonant energy. Its blows strike with immense force, capable of splintering even the toughest materials

Name: Kitsune Flame
Desc: A swirling wisp of mystical fire, said to be a direct fragment from a legendary Kitsune. It dances with an intelligent warmth and possesses a capricious, yet potent, magical energy

Name: Ancient Gloves
Desc: Worn and weathered, these gloves are crafted from materials long forgotten. Despite their age, they feel remarkably supple and imbue the wearer with a faint sense of timeless dexterity

Name: Ancient Wood Armor
Desc: Fashioned from the petrified wood of a primordial forest, this armor is incredibly tough yet surprisingly lightweight. It bears the markings of forgotten civilizations and seems to pulse with the deep, enduring life force of the ancient trees

Name: Aqua Lapis
Desc: A carefully carved piece of lapis that miraculously contains water in it. It makes you wonder how they were able to make it so perfectly.

Name: Arcane Mark
Desc: This spell is valuable despite the difficulty of using raw magic. By forming a weak barrier and releasing mana pulses, it creates strong magical ripples in a controlled area. However, due to high mana consumption, it is not advisable to cast an Arcane Mark larger than three times the size of a slime, as the area of effect impacts its effectiveness and duration.
Stat: Deals decent <purple>Magic</font> damage to enemy <red>if hits</font>, and has a chance to inflict <blue>Freeze</font>

Name: Beam Strike
Desc: Resting upon the grace of the Astral Orders, offer up a heartfelt prayer to call forth a swivelling, streamlined burst of stars, crashing down onto enemies with the blinding light of a supernova.
Stat: Deals high <purple>Magic</font> damage to enemy, inflict <yellow>Shocking</font> to enemy for a while

Name: Atlantis Armor
Desc: A subtle remnant of the ancient city Atlantis, lost to the inevitable passing of time. Considered a masterpiece to even most proficient armorsmiths throughout the ages, this intricate piece of armor is adorned with coral patterns and engravings symbolizing the marine life of the world, carved into the plates, glimmering with a faint blue.

Name: Adventurer's Kit
Desc: A ready-made kit for all adventurers to use and make, recommended to most beginners who are starting out.

Name: Bat Fang
Desc: Bats can have extremely sharp fangs for feeding, so be careful handling them!

Name: Beekeeper's Handwear
Desc: For how big bees are over here, I'm not sure how helpful these actually are... I mean, it's pretty durable for what it is―at least.
Stat: Bees will deal less damage to you

Name: Cursed Spellbook
Desc: This ancient, leather-bound tome thirsts for more than knowledge. Each spell cast from its pages demands a toll, drawing directly from the wielder's vitality, leaving them weakened but empowered. It is said that only those with an iron will, and a desperate need for power, dare to open its crimson-stained cover
Stat: For every attack, you will deal more damage, <red>with the cost of</font> 5% <green>Health</font>

Name: Spectral Ember
Desc: A chilling, ethereal flame that flickers with an otherworldly glow. It moves with an unnerving, intelligent drift, hinting at the lost souls and lingering energies from which it draws its cold, spectral light

Name: Blueberry
Desc: Small and round, sweet and nutritious. It's basically a bite-sized wonder! They should sell more of these around the world...

Name: Bread
Desc: A staple food for all adventurers, varies in quality from time to time, but this is what most adventurers get during their travels.

Name: Halloween Candy
Desc: Trick or treat! You got a treat!
Stat: Recover <green>10%</font> of your max health, become luckier until you left the game

Name: Chaotic Blast
Desc: Do you even know what you're casting anymore? Probably not. But hey, that's the reason this exists.
Stat: Cast a spellball towards enemy, and inflict <blue>R</font><green>a</font><yellow>n</font><red>d</font><grey>o</font><purple>n</font> effect

Name: Component
Desc: The key component of Sky Tower

Name: Cooked Steak
Desc: Most adventurers dream about eating cooked steak everyday once they get enough money, sadly most of them have to stick with bread or other simple foods most of the time.

Name: Copper Ore
Desc: A great conductor for electricity and heat, just make sure you don't use an electric spell whilst carrying some...

Name: Corrupted Fang
Desc: A twisted and dark fang, ripped from a creature tainted by dark magic. It pulses with an unstable, malevolent energy, hinting at the unnatural corruption that courses through it

Name: Crab Gaunlet
Desc: A formidable gauntlet crafted from the hardened shell and sharp claws of a giant crustacean. Its blows deliver a crushing force, reminiscent of a powerful pincer grip

Name: Shark's Spirit
Desc: A spectral, swirling vortex of water and predatory energy, embodying the relentless hunting prowess of the ocean's apex predator. It brings with it the chill of the deep and the swiftness of the currents

Name: Dual Swords
Desc: A matching pair of finely balanced blades, designed for fluid, rapid strikes. In the hands of a skilled warrior, they weave a deadly dance, overwhelming opponents with a flurry of precise attacks
Stat: For every attack, it will has a decent chance to perform an extra attack

Name: Electric Blast
Desc: A highly dangerous spell which uses magical particles as electrical conductors, creating artificial static which is subsequently heavily amplified to produce as much energy as an electric shock. Be sure to be cautious when using this spell.
Stat: Deals a decent <purple>Magic</font> damage and inflict <yellow>Shocking</font> to enemies it hits

Name: Electrified Gauntlet
Desc: This gauntlet crackles with raw, contained lightning. Each punch delivers a shocking jolt, capable of stunning foes and supercharging your strikes

Name: Everfrost Seed
Desc: A tiny, crystalline seed that radiates an intense, biting cold. It's said to contain the essence of an eternal winter, capable of freezing anything it touches given enough time

Name: Eternal Ember
Desc: A perpetual flame that burns without fuel, casting an unchanging, warm glow. It embodies enduring resilience and the unwavering spirit of life

Name: Perennial Bloom
Desc: A flower of impossible beauty that never wilts or fades. Its petals shimmer with an ethereal light, symbolizing enduring grace and the timeless cycle of nature

Name: Explosion
Desc: Mana can be utilised like a fuel, akin to coal; or like a flammable, combustible element, akin to oxygen. Hence, with enough mana and control, you can spread out mana across a large area and then quickly change all of their trajectories into one converging point before setting them ablaze, creating a chemical reaction akin to an explosion.
Stat: Long cast time, deals huge <purple>Magic</font> damage for all enemies in the area, inflict <red>Burn</font> and <yellow>Shocking</font>

Name: Pixie Scepter
Desc: This delicate wand, crafted from shimmering moonwood, hums with the playful magic of the fey. It channels pure, unadulterated enchantment, often with surprising and delightful results

Name: Blaze Bloom
Desc: A vibrant flower that pulses with an internal warmth, its petals seem to shimmer with tiny, dancing flames. It thrives in volcanic soil and is said to hold the raw energy of elemental fire

Name: Fish Stew
Desc: A hearty, simmering pot of tender fish, rich vegetables, and aromatic herbs. It's a humble, yet incredibly nourishing meal, perfect for restoring energy after a long journey or a tough battle

Name: Flame Strike
Desc: A burst of raw, uncontrolled fire that erupts from your hand, incinerating anything in its path. Its power is immense, but so is its volatile nature

Name: Frost Nova
Desc: A sudden, explosive burst of absolute zero. It radiates outwards from the caster, encasing everything in its radius in razor-sharp ice crystals and chilling the very air

Name: Frost Dagger
Desc: A chillingly sharp dagger forged from enchanted ice. Its touch leaves a biting cold, and its edge is said to slice through the very warmth of its targets, leaving behind a trail of frost

Name: Cinder Blade
Desc: This sword hums with the searing heat of a forge, its edge constantly aglow with embers. Every swing leaves a trail of scorching air, and its touch can ignite even the most stubborn materials

Name: Ancient Codex
Desc: This ancient book is bound in living bark and leaves, its pages filled with the secrets of the forest. It hums with the gentle energy of growth and life, holding forgotten remedies and nature's most subtle magics

Name: Grove Sovereign's Circlet
Desc: A crown woven from ancient vines, hardened wood, and the rarest forest blooms. It symbolizes the undisputed authority over the deep woods, granting its wearer a profound connection to all living things within the forest

Name: Gas
Desc: Compressed air that has been placed in an invisible magical vacuum, constantly expanding.

Name: Ghostly Lantern
Desc: Most creatures possess mana, which is released upon death. Similar to DNA, magical particles carry a signature unique to the creature, allowing only them to interact with their mana. This signature remains for a long time before expiring, enabling those who have proper magic control to manifest the will of the deceased to fulfill their final retributions.

Name: Gluttonous Necklace
Desc: This grotesque necklace is strung with what appear to be hardened, petrified organs. It hums with a dark, insatiable hunger, empowering its wearer at the cost of a constant, gnawing emptiness

Name: Gold Ore
Desc: Raw, high quality gold. Full of value, and fuller in your wallet.

Name: Sunstone Heart Pendant
Desc: A radiant pendant featuring a polished sunstone, warm to the touch and glowing with a gentle, golden light. It symbolizes purity and resilience, bestowing a comforting aura upon its wearer

Name: Golden Ring
Desc: A simple yet elegant ring crafted from pure, gleaming gold. It feels cool and smooth against the skin, a timeless symbol of wealth and status

Name: Ashen Harvester
Desc: A scythe-like weapon wreathed in the cold, silent essence of forgotten graves. Its edge is said to sever not just life, but the very hope from its victims, leaving only desolation in its wake

Name: Heart Gem
Desc: A flawless, pulsating gem that radiates a faint warmth. It's said to be imbued with pure life force, capable of invigorating the weary and mending deep wounds

Name: A Letter From Kris
Desc: A creased and faded letter, its parchment soft with age. The ink is slightly smudged in places, but the message within is clear—a personal plea or instruction from someone named Kris

Name: Hollow Knight Shield
Desc: This ancient shield is surprisingly lightweight, yet feels incredibly durable. Its surface bears the worn emblem of a forgotten order, suggesting a history of stoic defense against unseen threats

Name: Holy Smite
Desc: A divine surge of concentrated light and righteous fury. When unleashed, it calls down a punishing beam from the heavens, searing those who stand in its sacred path

Name: Hot Potato
Desc: A magical potato capable of absorbing any heat without suffering the damaging effects. It is said this specific potato was the first successful creation of making food that stayed warm and fresh in cold temperatures as a way to combat the unbearable temperatures of the Tundra, but it was too powerful and is now eternally engulfed in flames.

Name: Ice Dagger
Desc: A chillingly sharp dagger, seemingly carved from pure, solidified ice. Its touch leaves a lingering cold, and its edge is said to slice through the very warmth of its targets

Name: Glacial Edge Blade
Desc: This energy sword hums with the frigid power of an ancient glacier. Its blade is composed of super-cooled energy, capable of freezing anything it cuts on contact

Name: Ice Crystal
Desc: A flawless, multifaceted crystal radiating an intense, biting cold. It's incredibly pure and often used in powerful freezing enchantments

Name: Joke Apple
Desc: A brightly colored, seemingly ordinary apple that, when bitten into, delivers a surprising and harmless, yet memorable, burst of silly confetti or a comical sound
Stat: Recover <green>10%-50%</font> of your max health, randomly

Name: Kitsune Fur
Desc: Luxuriously soft and shimmering, this fur is said to have been shed by a mystical Kitsune. It feels warm and alive to the touch, often displaying subtle shifts in color under different lights

Name: Kitsune Gloves
Desc: These supple gloves are crafted from the magical fur of a Kitsune. They feel light as air and are whispered to grant enhanced agility and a touch of elusive charm to the wearer.

Name: Azure Tear
Desc: A shimmering, teardrop-shaped crystal of profound blue, said to be a crystallized drop of sorrow from a celestial being. It emanates a calm, serene energy

Name: Abyssal Heartstone
Desc: A dark, pulsating stone retrieved from the deepest trenches of the ocean. It throbs with the immense pressure and ancient power of the abyss, emanating a mysterious, chilling presence

Name: Purple Crystal
Desc: A raw, unpolished crystal radiating a deep, vibrant purple hue. It hums with a quiet, enigmatic energy, often associated with mystery and subtle magical properties

Name: Light
Desc: By manipulating magic particles into a crystal structure and freezing them into microscopic ridges, it forms polaritons when interacting with light to create a supersolid matter. In this way, 'physical light' is created.

Name: Lightning Blast
Desc: A sudden, violent discharge of raw electrical energy. It rips through the air, striking targets with blinding speed and immense force, leaving a lingering scent of ozone

Name: Lightning Scroll
Desc: A brittle, parchment scroll crackling with contained electrical energy. When unfurled, it unleashes a focused bolt of lightning, guided by ancient runes

Name: Lumiscent Crystal
Desc: A flawless crystal that emits a soft, internal glow, casting a gentle light even in the darkest environments. It seems to absorb and radiate ambient magic

Name: Lux
Desc: A concentrated sphere of pure, radiant light. It repels shadows and dissipates dark energies, acting as both a beacon and a protective aura

Name: Magic Wand
Desc: A slender rod of polished wood or enchanted metal, subtly humming with arcane potential. It acts as a conduit for a spellcaster's will, focusing their magical energies into potent effects

Name: Mana Amulet
Desc: A finely crafted amulet that gently pulses with a calming blue light. Wearing it helps to stabilize and increase a magic-user's connection to the mystical energies of the world

Name: Mana Gauge
Desc: A small, intricate device with a shimmering needle, designed to visually represent the ebb and flow of magical energy. It allows a spellcaster to precisely monitor their arcane reserves

Name: Metal Plate
Desc: A simple metal plate, it's not much, but it does the job.

Name: Milk Pillow
Desc: A soft, cloud-like pillow, said to be filled with the essence of pure, calming moonlight. Resting on it grants incredibly peaceful sleep and awakens you feeling refreshed

Name: Mountain King's Crown
Desc: A heavy, stone-forged crown adorned with jagged, unpolished gems. It hums with the ancient power of the earth, symbolizing dominion over peaks and caverns alike

Name: Mushroom
Desc: A simple, unassuming fungus. While many are edible and nourishing, some hide potent magical properties, or even deadly toxins

Name: Red Necklace
Desc: A vibrant necklace strung with polished crimson stones. It exudes a faint warmth and is often associated with passion, courage, or sometimes, raw power

Name: Northerner Armor
Desc: Thick, fur-lined armor designed to withstand the harshest blizzards and the coldest winds. It's built for resilience and protection in unforgiving frozen lands

Name: Northerner Helm
Desc: A sturdy, fur-trimmed helmet crafted for the brutal conditions of the north. It offers crucial protection while keeping the wearer's head warm and vision clear against snow and ice

Name: Northerner Axe
Desc: A heavy, single-bladed axe with a well-worn handle, built for chopping through both frozen timber and hardened foes. It's a reliable tool for survival and combat in the frigid north

Name: Teleportation Spell
Desc: A complex arcane incantation that warps space itself. With enough concentration, it allows the caster to instantly travel across short distances, appearing and disappearing in a flash of mystical energy

Name: Phoenix Feather
Desc: The bird ignites their nest ablaze and dies in it's own flames, but from its ashes, a new, younger phoenix is born, ready to begin its own life cycle

Name: Pumpkin
Desc: A round, orange gourd, often associated with autumn harvests and festive celebrations. While some are simply decorative, others hold hidden magical properties or serve as a vital ingredient for hearty meals

Name: Rabbit's Foot
Desc: It's unknown where this foot came from, or how it's still intact. What you do know however is that you feel a lot less heavy whilst having it equipped. What an enigma...

Name: Crimson Orb of Insight
Desc: A mesmerizing, blood-red orb that seems to peer into hidden truths. It is rumored to grant glimpses of foresight, though at a cost to the user's perception of reality

Name: Red Banner
Desc: A vibrant flag, emblazoned with a striking crimson hue. It symbolizes courage, passion, or a fierce rallying cry for a specific faction or cause

Name: Redfox Spear
Desc: A light and agile spear adorned with the distinctive red fur and sharp teeth of a Redfox. It's designed for swift, cunning attacks, mirroring the animal's predatory nature

Name: Rock Armor
Desc: Heavy, cumbersome armor crafted from crude, reinforced stone plates. It offers incredible defense against physical blows, turning its wearer into a near-immovable bulwark

Name: Rock Hammer
Desc: A crude, yet incredibly powerful hammer, fashioned from a heavy stone head and a sturdy wooden haft. Its immense weight makes every swing a devastating blow, capable of shattering defenses

Name: Rune Stone
Desc: A smooth, ancient stone etched with glowing, mystical symbols. It pulses with faint energy, holding a fraction of a forgotten spell or a piece of ancient lore

Name: Inferno Rune Shard
Desc: A fragment of a larger rune, still burning with an internal, contained flame. It radiates intense heat and is a potent component for fire-based enchantments or volatile explosives

Name: Honing Whetstone
Desc: A coarse, durable stone designed to refine and sharpen bladed weapons. Its abrasive surface revitalizes dull edges, allowing for cleaner cuts and more effective strikes

Name: Shocking Spell
Desc: A sudden, powerful jolt of electrical energy that can stun and incapacitate foes. It's quick, precise, and leaves a tingling sensation in its wake

Name: Shrimp
Desc: A small, aquatic crustacean. While often a simple food source, some rare varieties are said to possess unique magical properties when consumed

Name: Seafood Scampi
Desc: A savory dish featuring succulent shrimp sautéed with garlic, butter, and fragrant herbs, often served over noodles or rice. A delicious and restorative meal for any adventurer

Name: Slash
Desc: A swift, broad cutting motion with a bladed weapon. It's a fundamental combat technique, capable of hitting multiple targets or delivering a wide, sweeping strike

Name: Slime King Crown???
Desc: A crown once held by the notorious and fierce Slime King, brimming with the same ferocious energy that composed it's viscous body. Legends once said that the crown of the Slime King has been passed through creature to creature for millenium, granting it's wearer the combined power of all previous wearers of the same species.

Name: Spell Barrage
Desc: Well, it's not perfect nor efficient but it does the job. Not every mage has the time to cast coherent spells in any particular order or reason. By using this to siphon random elements whilst using the structure of a low-grade projectile spell, you've effectively created an unpredictable shower on the enemy. One spell may shock them, the other may burn, and the other may freeze them right after.

Name: Stalker Cape
Desc: A dark, tattered cape woven from deep forest foliage. It seems to absorb ambient light, allowing the wearer to blend seamlessly into shadows and move with uncanny silence

Name: Stalker Leaf
Desc: A single, unusually large leaf, remarkably resilient and unnaturally still, even in a breeze. It's said to whisper secrets of the forest to those who know how to listen

Name: Star Blast
Desc: A brilliant, concentrated burst of cosmic energy, ripped from the very fabric of the night sky. It explodes on impact, showering an area with shimmering, destructive starlight

Name: Thorned Tunic
Desc: A rough tunic crafted from thick, woven fibers embedded with sharp, natural thorns. While uncomfortable to wear, it offers a painful surprise to anyone who dares to strike its wearer

Name: Shadow Shards
Desc: A set of slender, obsidian-like projectiles, perfectly weighted for throwing. They seem to vanish and reappear in the blink of an eye, delivering silent, precise strikes from a distance

Name: Verdant Cleaver
Desc: A sturdy axe with a blade shaped like a broad leaf, crafted from resilient forest wood and sharp, reinforced edges. It's designed for quick, decisive strikes, mirroring the swiftness of nature

Name: Venom Stinger
Desc: A wickedly sharp, chitinous barb pulsing with a visible, sickly green ichor. Its slightest touch injects a potent, debilitating poison into its victim

Name: Volatile Gem
Desc: A raw, unpolished gem that pulsates with erratic, untamed energy. It hums with a dangerous power, capable of unleashing unpredictable elemental bursts if not handled with extreme care

Name: Warrior's Pride
Desc: Anything can be used as a basis for a magic spell, even just your hand. By creating a faint trail of magic and making a slashing motion before fully amplifying and materialising that trail, you can create a simple but powerful attack. This was one of the earliest magic-based attacks usable by warriors in the early ages, hence it is usually referred to as a Warrior's Pride

Name: Will-o'-Wisp
Desc: A small, ethereal ball of flickering, ghostly light. It drifts with an otherworldly grace, sometimes guiding the lost, other times leading travelers astray into forgotten realms
